summary: Allocates a new 32-byte actor node and appends it to a singly-linked list rooted at this+0x0. First rejects duplicates: if UTF16StringSearchInLinkedList finds the name already present, it formats 'Actor %s already exists' through StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and returns -1. Otherwise it walks the list to the tail using the +0x1C next-pointer field, allocates 32 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, zero-initializes the node via SmallStructInitWithParentCall, links it (as new head if the list was empty, otherwise as the old tail's next), fills the node via StringCopyFieldInit, and returns 0.

operations.description: Duplicate guard: if UTF16StringSearchInLinkedList(a2) returns non-zero, the actor name already exists in the list.
On duplicate, format the 'Actor %s already exists' error string (global 0x005DC1A4) into the local 256-byte stack buffer v11 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck.
Return -1 when the actor name is already present.
Branch on the list head pointer stored at this+0x0: if it is non-null the new node is appended to the existing tail; if it is null the new node becomes the list head.
Walk the singly-linked list from the head, following the +0x1C next-pointer field of each node (obj+0x1C), until the last node is reached.
Allocate 32 bytes for the new node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
Zero-initialize the freshly allocated 32-byte node via SmallStructInitWithParentCall.

Link the node into the list: if the list was empty, store the new node at this+0x0 (this was previously 0); otherwise store it into the old tail node's next-pointer at +0x1C, i.e. *(*(obj+0x1C)+0x1C) = new node. On allocation failure the tail next is set to 0 and this+0x0 is left at 0.
Copy the actor name (a2) and the two integer arguments (a3, a4) into the initialized node via StringCopyFieldInit.
